description: This file defines the CustomField class within the OrangeHRM project, representing custom fields for various entities. It includes properties such as field number, name, type, associated screen, and extra data, along with constants for field types and screens.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: ORM entity class representing custom fields for various HR modules, with properties for field number, name, type, screen, and extra data, along with associated constants for field types and screen identifiers.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the custom field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the custom field.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the custom field.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the custom field.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the associated screen for the custom field.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the associated screen for the custom field.

methods.name: getExtraData
methods.description: Returns additional data associated with the custom field.

methods.name: setExtraData
methods.description: Sets additional data for the custom field.
